compatibility_requirements: rows C3.S3, C3.S4 and C3.S5 are SERVICE_LOCAL until a consumer exists
no silent latest: an unknown knowledge, artifact or evaluator version is refused
consumer evidence is none at this stage and no compatibility claim is made
prior stage artifacts, symbols and tests remain byte-identical

deferred_threats.reason: Publication refusal is enforced by the B6-I9 platform gate under the explicit operator publication hold; B6-I5 has no packaging, publication, or cloud capability

deferred_work: C4 adapter contract, translation, isolation and certification (B6-I6)
C5 second application and reuse measurement (B6-I7)
independent API, security, compatibility and recovery audit (B6-I8)
platform gate and downstream dependency contract (B6-I9)
packaging or publication of any artifact: NOT_AUTHORIZED
cloud hosting or provider coupling: NOT_AUTHORIZED
T19 publication refusal deferred to operator/B6-I9 platform gate (amendment 001)
evidence_requirements: contract, scope and registry are committed and frozen before any result is recorded
every requirement is bound to a named executed node, never to a badge or a narrative
the mutation battery runs at or above the floor of 3 and restores pristine bytes
the provenance chain reconciles end-to-end from fact to artifact to evaluation to decision
tamper, substitution and stale-version refusals are recorded with their digests
independence evidence shows the builder cannot alter, execute or approve its own result
the exact base/head paired comparison runs against the B6-I4 merge with common floor 208
validator output, node totals and cleanup proof report zero failures, errors and skips
evidence JSON is deterministic and carries hashes, sizes and commit identity, never a wall clock
exit_gate: provenance, tamper and independent gate pass
provenance_obligations: every governed fact carries a source reference and a digest before it is retrievable
knowledge stays separate from agent memory and shares no mutable store with it
retrieval is scoped to one tenant, project and scope and refuses any wider read
an artifact is registered once with an immutable digest and size and is never overwritten
a served artifact must equal its manifest digest; a different artifact for a name is refused
a result recorded by the evaluation service cannot be replaced, only superseded by a new run id
the evaluator definition is digest-bound so a builder cannot silently change it
a promotion decision requires a gate result and an approver that is not the builder
the provenance chain reconciles fact, artifact, evaluation and decision end-to-end
purpose: C3 knowledge, artifact and evaluation services
stop_conditions: stop if builder can alter evaluator
